suites.name: Binary attachment helpers
tests: A call without a binary argument is not treated as an attachment
Null args are not treated as an attachment
A byte array argument is extracted as attachment content
A string after the binary argument is used as the file name
A string before the binary argument stays a format argument
A blank file name is ignored
A stream is read from the start even if already consumed
Default file name for PDF content gets a pdf extension
Default file name for label pdf with unknown content still gets pdf extension
Default file name for unknown content falls back to bin
Default file name keeps an existing extension
Default file name sanitizes invalid characters and empty labels
Content sniffing returns nothing for short content
Message formatting applies arguments and survives a bad format string
